Shared ticketing and documentation with your team

features: Multi-channel support: phone, email, chat, portal

services.summary: Patching, updates and health checks that stop problems before they start.

features: Automated patch management for OS and third-party apps

services.summary: 24/7 monitoring that catches failures before your team feels them.
services.description: Every workstation and server in your environment is watched around the clock for CPU, memory, disk, and service failures. Alerts route straight to our engineers, who triage and resolve issues — often before anyone notices a slowdown.
features: Disk, memory, and performance threshold tracking

services.name: Virtual CIO Services
services.summary: Strategic technology leadership without a full-time executive salary.
services.description: A dedicated vCIO gets to know your business goals and builds a technology roadmap around them — budgeting, vendor management, risk planning, and quarterly business reviews — so IT decisions support growth instead of reacting to it.
features: Quarterly technology roadmap and budget planning

services.name: Endpoint Management
services.summary: Centralised control and security for every device that touches your network.
services.description: From laptops to point-of-sale devices, we enrol, configure, secure, and monitor every endpoint from a single console — enforcing consistent security policy no matter where your team works.

services.name: IT Procurement
services.summary: The right hardware and software, sourced and configured for you.
services.description: We take vendor research, quoting, and configuration off your plate — sourcing hardware and licensing at competitive rates, pre-configuring it to your standards, and handling warranty and lifecycle tracking.

services.name: Mobile Device Management (MDM)
services.summary: Secure, manage, and track every phone and tablet in your fleet.
services.description: Enforce passcodes, encryption, and app policies, push updates remotely, and wipe lost or stolen devices in seconds — keeping company data safe on every mobile device your team uses.
features: Remote lock and wipe for lost devices

services.name: IT Project Management
services.summary: Dedicated project management for migrations, rollouts and upgrades.
services.description: Office moves, cloud migrations, network overhauls — big IT projects need a dedicated project manager, not a part-time volunteer. We scope, schedule, and deliver projects on time with clear milestones and communication.

services.name: Apple Support
services.summary: Specialist support for Mac, iPhone, and iPad in a business environment.
services.description: Apple devices need Apple-specific expertise — from Jamf/MDM enrolment to integrating macOS into a Windows-heavy network. Our certified specialists keep your Apple fleet productive and secure.
features: Apple Business Manager and MDM enrolment

categories.name: Professional IT Services

services.name: Technology Alignment Process
services.summary: A structured review that maps your technology to your business goals.
services.description: We audit your current stack, compare it against where the business is heading, and deliver a prioritised roadmap — closing gaps and eliminating tools that no longer earn their keep.

services.name: Google Workspace Optimization
services.summary: Get more out of Gmail, Drive, Meet, and the rest of Google Workspace.
services.description: From account security and storage policy to shared drive structure and automation, we tune Google Workspace to fit how your team actually works, and train your staff to use it well.
features: Shared drive and storage structure clean-up

services.name: Microsoft 365 Optimization
services.summary: Unlock the full value of Teams, SharePoint, Exchange, and Intune.
services.description: Most businesses use a fraction of what Microsoft 365 offers. We configure security baselines, SharePoint/Teams structure, and Intune device policy so you get enterprise-grade capability without the enterprise complexity.
features: Security baseline and conditional access setup

services.name: IT Audit & Compliance
services.summary: Independent audits that keep you ready for regulators, insurers, and clients.
services.description: We assess your environment against the frameworks that matter to your industry, document findings clearly, and help you remediate gaps before they become audit failures or breach liabilities.

services.name: Business Continuity
services.summary: Plans and systems that keep you operating through disruption.
services.description: We build and test continuity and disaster recovery plans covering data, systems, and communication — so a fire, outage, or ransomware event is a bad day, not a business-ending one.
features: Disaster recovery plan design and testing

categories.name: IT Security
categories.summary: Layered protection across your people, endpoints, network, and data — monitored 24/7.

services.name: Managed SOC
services.summary: A 24/7 security operations centre watching your environment.
services.description: Our managed SOC combines automated threat detection with human analysts monitoring your network, endpoints, and cloud around the clock — investigating alerts and responding before minor incidents become breaches.

services.name: Data Backups & Disaster Recovery
services.summary: Automated backups and tested recovery, so data loss is never final.
services.description: We design a backup strategy across on-site, cloud, and offsite copies, monitor backup jobs daily, and run regular recovery tests — so when something goes wrong, restoring data is fast and predictable.

services.name: Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR)
services.summary: Behaviour-based threat detection on every laptop, desktop, and server.
services.description: Traditional antivirus misses modern threats. EDR watches for suspicious behaviour in real time, automatically isolates compromised devices, and gives our analysts the forensic detail to respond fast.

services.name: Security Awareness Training
services.summary: Turn your employees into your strongest line of defence.
services.description: Most breaches start with a click. We run ongoing phishing simulations and bite-sized training so employees recognise social engineering, report suspicious activity, and build lasting security habits.

services.name: Email Security
services.summary: Advanced filtering that stops phishing, malware, and spoofing before it lands.
services.description: We layer advanced spam and phishing filtering, attachment sandboxing, and domain authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC) on top of your existing mailboxes to stop the single most common attack vector.

services.name: Managed Detection & Response
services.summary: Combined technology and human analysts hunting threats across your stack.
services.description: MDR layers expert-led threat hunting on top of your security tools — correlating signals across endpoints, network, and cloud to catch attacks that automated tools alone would miss, with rapid analyst-led response.

services.name: Penetration Testing
services.summary: Ethical hackers stress-test your defences before real attackers do.
services.description: Our testers simulate real-world attacks against your network, applications, and people to uncover exploitable weaknesses — delivered as a clear, prioritised report your team can act on immediately.
